chapter: The Legends of Jazz and life on the road
title: Legends of Jazz personnel
summary: Blakeney lists the original Legends of Jazz players and later replacements such as Adolphus Morris and Clyde Bernhardt.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Let's talk about your experiences with the Legends Of Jazz, after your rehearsing here in Los Angeles at Local 47 and your initial engagements with this group, and they were indeed legends. Mention to us once more first of all the personnel in that band.
The personnel with the Legends was 'Montudie' Garland on bass, Louis Nelson on trombone, Joe Darensbourg on clarinet, myself on trumpet, Barry Martyn on drums, and Alton Purnell on piano.
Is that group still pretty much in tact with the same kind of personnel?
some since then. Louis Nelson isn't a regular with the band anymore; he comes in every once in a while.
Purnell is still with the band, and myself I'm supposed to be with the band if I ever get back to work.
I'm sure you will. We're just so happy that you're up and about again.
That's about all of the originals of the band. Joe Darensbourg is not with the band anymore, he got tired of travelling.
(Side B of Tape 2 ended at this point.)
--Clyde Bernhardt on the trombone took Louis Nelson's place.
For the most part the personnel has been pretty stable.
